message: You know, they say preparation is the key to a smooth storm season. I always thought that was just a clever saying until I found myself in a thunderstorm with nothing but a half-hearted umbrella and a cat who was convinced the world was ending. Turns out, a little knowledge goes a long way! If you want to avoid my soggy situation, check out this handy resource on thunderstorms and lightning. Just remember, when the winds pick up, it’s best to be ready—unless you enjoy the thrill of being soaked to the bone! ☔️
